newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Supreme Court to announce Bhutto verdict soon.
newsitem.headline: Supreme Court to announce Bhutto verdict soon.

text.p: Pakistan's Supreme Court will announce its verdict on ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto's plea against her dismissal at 3.30 p.m. (1030 GMT) on Wednesday, the chief justice said.
Sajjad Ali Shah announced before the seven-judge bench retired at 2.10 p.m. to consider its verdict that the judgement would be announced 80 minutes later.

Bhutto is appealing against President Farooq Leghari's November 5 sacking of her government for alleged corruption and misrule. If the court upholds Leghari's action, national and provincial elections will go ahead on Monday as planned.
